scope: Confirm whether a purchase selector can identify the net correction obtained from the frozen original camera, using only the currently available free audio. Separate experiment for natural information arrival; preserve previously published 24-query results.
cohort: New licensed actual piano/guitar performances, excluding all previous selected recordings, uploaders and production groups. Train/dev/test each have both instruments, with disjoint original recordings, performers/production clusters and uploaders. Source lists and split assignments fixed before outcomes. Four disjoint 2.88-second intervals per recording. Verify physical source integrity without using scores. Document all acquisitions, exclusions and denominators; no post-score case replacements. Prices and previously trained free/paid frontends are frozen.
target: At the first decision point, residual correct(camera)-correct(audio) is in {-1,0,+1}. Buy only if predicted incremental accuracy strictly exceeds 0.30 plus the registered reserve. Available inputs are the current free class posterior, free reference scores and acoustic representation. Predicted gain, actual rescues, harms, redundant buys and misses all reported. Weights assign equal mass per production source, then equal mass per episode. No source, true label, camera, or later frame enters the selection at inference.
candidates: Always stop, always buy, empirical global accuracy gain, class+confidence+gallery-disagreement cells with source shrinkage 2 or 6, two centered ridge-SVD models (penalties .1 or 1) on free reliability cues with and without eight frozen sound projections, source-balanced nearest-neighbour radial smoother, fixed tanh expansion and the same expansion with 16 profiled outer BP steps. Deterministic random initialization 181391. Target is raw correction; learned models evaluated at extra reserves 0 and .10. Always stop and always buy are available without fit.
selection: All fitted candidates are trained only on new TRAIN. Refit separately leaving each source out to estimate train selection robustness. Rank by DEV source macro utility, worst DEV source difference vs free, leave-one-source-out TRAIN macro utility, then prespecified candidate order. Train+dev data not pooled after selection. One primary winner including both static policies, one explicitly secondary active selector from learned candidates only. Freeze policies, thresholds, data bindings, old frontend and selector code before any new TEST score or camera inference. Report all registered candidates on TEST solely as diagnosis.
baselines: Immediate free, immediate paid, published #6988 table and frozen same-price #6988 read-capable and no-read physical/SVD/BP heads on the new observations. Earlier #6988 TEST serves only as historical context.
primary_adoption: On genuinely new TEST the selected policy must buy selectively, beat BOTH always-free and always-paid in source-macro net utility by at least .03, worst source difference vs free >= -.05, and exact paired source sign test on both contrasts must pass Holm familywise .05 (ties removed, one-sided), conditional on the observed grouping. If either source panel or the policy fails, report the failed criterion without tuning evaluation.
uncertainty: Report all per-source, nominal counts, source sign tests and descriptive calibration per predicted raw gain in (-infinity,0],(0,.30],(.30,.50],(.50,infinity). Calibration bins use observed probabilities only at evaluation. Cost measurements include all candidates, leave-source refits, development selection, fresh confirmation and validation.
fallback: When sourcing cannot provide enough fresh groups within accessible sources, state what was actually acquired and continue independent research checks. A failed primary comparison is a registered scientific result. No post-holdout retries on the same panel.
